items.title: Professional Pensions schedules webinar on UK infrastructure investment
items.summary: According to Professional Pensions, online session held in association with Gravis to explore public and private asset routes for pension schemes.

items.title: Anthropic IPO highlights AI liability risks and capacity concerns for insurers
items.summary: According to Reinsurance News, morningstar DBRS warns that catastrophic artificial intelligence liabilities could exceed industry capacity as Anthropic files for a US stock market listing.

items.title: Florida files lawsuit against climate risk modeling firm First Street Technology
items.summary: According to Insurance Journal, state attorney general accuses the climate modeler of using flawed science to issue property risk scores that affect home values and insurance costs.

items.title: Six Flags to Install Seat Belts on Georgia Roller Coaster Following Fatal Incident
items.summary: According to Insurance Journal, theme park operator Six Flags is adding seat belts to its Goliath roller coaster in Georgia and similar rides across its network after a fatal accident earlier this month.

items.title: Globe Telecom Executive Wins Parima Next-Gen Risk Takers Award
items.summary: According to Commercial Risk, alexis Huebert Dolor of Globe Telecom Inc in the Philippines has been named the winner of Parima’s Next Gen Risk Takers challenge.

items.title: The Hartford Reports 23% Rise in Q3 Net Income
items.summary: According to Reinsurance News, the US insurance provider records $1.3 billion in net income for the third quarter of 2026, alongside premium growth and leadership transition plans.
